## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
DDWRT offers two status pages for connected clients: Status_Wireless.live.asp and Status_Lan.live.asp.
Both have different sets of connected clients.
Before the change, when setting `wireless_only: false` only the Status_Lan.live.asp page would be fetched and processed, ignoring all connected wireless clients.
With this change, both status pages are fetched and processed when `wireless_only: false` is set.
If `wireless_only: true` is set, only the Status_Wireless.live.asp page is processed, as before.

See https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/56519 for the related issue report.

issue_context.title: DD-WRT device_tracker logic error
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The [DD-WRT](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ddwrt/) device_tracker platform has a config option `wireless_only: <bool>` that's documented as
> Whether to only list devices that are connected directly to the router via Wi-Fi or include those connected via Ethernet or other networked access points as well.

Looking at the code, setting `wireless_only: false` does not return wireless **and** LAN clients as the description suggests, but **only** LAN clients.

The `_update_info(self)` function uses this setting to determine the URL to retreive from the device:
```python
        endpoint = "Wireless" if self.wireless_only else "Lan"
        url = f"{self.protocol}://{self.host}/Status_{endpoint}.live.asp"
        data = self.get_ddwrt_data(url)
```
In case of `wireless_only: false` only the "Status_Lan.live.asp" web page is retrieved, but never the "Status_Wireless.live.asp".
Both web pages have different sets of information - the "Lan" page basically contains an ARP table dump while the "Wireless" page has a list of connected wireless clients. The wireless MAC addresses are not part of the "Lan" page output.

So for this option to work as expected, the `_update_info(self)` function needs to fetch and process **both** pages in case `wireless_only: false` is set.
But currently only one of those is retrieved.




### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

DD-WRT

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ddwrt/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
platform: ddwrt
host: xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx
username: myuser
password: secret
wireless_only: false
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

This a an “else” to the “if” in line 122.

No. The original logic was "if (false) do A else do B", while it should have been "Do A. If (false) also do B."

We always want to get the wireless status page. And if "wireless_only" is set to "false", we also get the "Lan" status page.
